description: Founders of Lagos’ new-age underground festival, FREEWATER, join NTS for a 6-show residency, diving deep into the next wave of Nigerian music. Each hour-long show explores our favorite jams from the city’s bubbling alternative scene, covering alt-afro, indie, electronic, and trap sounds shaping the future of Lagos’ underground.
title: Freewater w/ Wasé Taiwo & VNTAGEPARADISE
